hebrewText: וְֽ/צַדִּיקִ֗ים יִשְׂמְח֣וּ יַֽ֭עַלְצוּ לִ/פְנֵ֥י אֱלֹהִ֗ים וְ/יָשִׂ֥ישׂוּ בְ/שִׂמְחָֽה

tokens.bdb: probably to brighten up, i.e. (figuratively) be (causatively, make) blithe or gleesome
tokens.kjv: cheer up, be (make) glad, (have, make) joy(-ful), be (make) merry, (cause to, make to) rejoice, [idiom] very.

tokens.bdb: to jump for joy, i.e. exult
the face (as the part that turns); used in a great variety of applications (literally and figuratively); also (with prepositional prefix) as a preposition (before, etc.)
